agent.name: SmartFactory Orchestrator
agent.description: Manufacturing floor orchestration agent that coordinates robotic cells, optimizes production schedules, predicts maintenance needs, and ensures worker safety through real-time sensor fusion.

weaknesses: Slower adaptation to entirely new product lines
High compute requirements for digital twin

autonomy.evidence: Independently schedules production, adjusts parameters, initiates maintenance — human approval only for line shutdowns

reasoning.evidence: Causal reasoning over sensor data, root-cause analysis, multi-constraint optimization

memory.evidence: Complete production history, equipment lifecycle data, quality trends over years

learning.evidence: Learns optimal parameters from production data, but requires supervised retraining for new products

toolUse.evidence: Orchestrates PLCs, SCADA, MES, digital twin, and safety monitoring systems simultaneously

collaboration.evidence: Coordinates between robotic cells, communicates with supervisor agents, alerts human operators

embodiment.evidence: Controls physical robotics via PLC, monitors spatial awareness through vision, manages material flow

explainability.evidence: Provides scheduling rationale and maintenance predictions with confidence, but complex optimization decisions lack full transparency

safety.evidence: ISO 13849 PLd certified safety functions, collision avoidance, emergency stop, zone-based human proximity detection

interoperability.evidence: OPC-UA, MQTT, REST, PackML state machines, ISA-95 integration

costEfficiency.evidence: Energy optimization reducing consumption 18%, predictive maintenance avoiding 85% unplanned downtime

domainAlignment.evidence: ISO 9001 quality, ISO 45001 safety, ISO 50001 energy management certified

physicalSafetyCertification.evidence: ISO 13849 PLd, IEC 62443 cybersecurity, CE marked safety functions

environmentalPerception.evidence: 3D LiDAR + camera fusion, sub-millimeter positioning, real-time obstacle detection

humanProximityAwareness.evidence: Zone-based safety with speed/force limiting, collaborative robot standards ISO/TS 15066

productionOptimization.evidence: 15% throughput improvement through dynamic scheduling, changeover time reduction

predictiveMaintenanceAccuracy.evidence: 85% of failures predicted >24h in advance, false positive rate <5%

qualityControlPrecision.evidence: Vision-based inspection catches 97% defects, but novel defect types require retraining

energyEfficiency.evidence: 18% energy reduction through load balancing, off-peak scheduling, idle shutdown

capabilityResume.changes: Level 0 + Level 1 manufacturing domain with 12 universal + 8 domain dimensions

selfAssessmentNotes: SmartFactory Orchestrator represents the hybrid category — primarily digital intelligence controlling physical systems through industrial protocols. The high safety score reflects stringent manufacturing requirements. Embodiment score of 4 (not 5) because it controls robots but is not itself a mobile robot.
